newsitem.title: USA: Texas Pacific closes purchase of Del Monte Foods.
newsitem.headline: Texas Pacific closes purchase of Del Monte Foods.

text.p: An investor group led by Texas Pacific Group said Friday that it had completed its acquisition of Del Monte Foods Co, the nation's largest branded manufacturer of canned fruits and vegetables.
Texas Pacific did not disclose terms, but previous reports have said the buyout totals more than $800 million.
The acquisition includes all of Del Monte's packaged food products sold under its name in U.S. markets, which number more than 375 brand items, the group said.
Texas Pacific Group, based in San Francisco and Fort Worth, Texas, manages TPG Partners LP, a private investment partnership whose principals include David Bonderman, James Coulter and William Price.
Texas Pacific also owns Favorite Brands International, a confections business it purchased in 1995 from Philip Morris' Kraft Foods Inc, and Beringer Wine Estates, which it bought in 1996.

"Del Monte is one of the best known brands in the United States, and its acquisition represents a significant step forward for us as we follow our growth strategy in the food and beverage sector," Texas Pacific Group said in a statement.
